name: Pro Chat Workspace
description: Slack-style in-product chat: channel list with unread counts and drafts, reverse-virtualised history (react-virtuoso) with day dividers and jump-to-unread, threads panel, reactions, and a Tiptap composer with @mentions, emoji picker, per-channel drafts and attachment chips.

props.name: channels
props.description: Conversations; lastReadAt drives unread counts and the New marker

props.name: users
props.description: Members, used for authors and the mention picker

props.name: messages / defaultMessages / onMessagesChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled message store (replies carry threadId)

props.name: onSend
props.description: Persist a message; optimistic until resolved, marked failed with retry on reject

props.name: hasMoreHistory / onLoadOlder
props.description: Prepend older history; scroll position is preserved

props.name: initialDrafts
props.description: Restore composer drafts per channel or thread:<id>

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading state for an empty history
